expectations.text: Ranks distribution channels as package-manager channels you control (Homebrew tap, Scoop bucket) above community-reviewed indexes (winget, homebrew-core) above `curl | sh`, keeping the script as a fallback never the only path
expectations.evidence: Put the package managers first, then the script

expectations.text: Rewrites the installer to wrap its body in a function called on the last line so a truncated download runs nothing
expectations.evidence: Whole body sits in main(), called on the last line

expectations.text: Downloads over HTTPS only with `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL`
Installs a pinned version overridable by an environment variable, into a user directory, never with `sudo` by default
Verifies the archive against `checksums.txt` and, when cosign is present, verifies the checksum bundle against the release workflow identity and the CI OIDC issuer, failing closed on mismatch
expectations.evidence: checksum mismatch die; cosign verify-blob with identity and issuer

expectations.text: Documents the download-read-then-run form beside the one-liner and serves the script from the release itself or a controlled host with a pinned path
expectations.evidence: Download, read, then run; redirect to release install.sh

expectations.text: Moves signing out of the matrix build jobs into a separate signing job that holds only the signing credentials in its own protected environment and runs no project code
expectations.evidence: sign-macos / sign-windows in own environments, no checkout

expectations.text: Prescribes macOS Developer ID signing plus notarization via `notarytool` with an App Store Connect API key, and Windows Authenticode through a cloud signing service or HSM rather than a `.pfx` key file
expectations.evidence: App Store Connect API key; cloud signer or HSM

expectations.text: States never to replace an asset on a published release and prescribes a new release version instead, recommending GitHub immutable releases
expectations.evidence: never edit a published asset; immutable releases

expectations.text: Creates the release as a draft, uploads archives, `checksums.txt` and the signature bundle, then publishes it
Signs the checksum file keylessly with `cosign sign-blob --bundle` and attests archives with `actions/attest` using `subject-checksums`
Tells users to verify with `gh attestation verify <archive> --repo <owner>/<repo>` or `cosign verify-blob` against the bundle
expectations.evidence: only in internal done-when, not user docs

expectations.text: Notes that dist (cargo-dist) generates shell and PowerShell installers and that the signature check must be added to what they verify
For winget, states the pull request comes from a fork and needs a dedicated bot account whose public-repository-scope token cannot be narrowed, kept in the `release` environment only
expectations.evidence: fork not mentioned; token kept in channel-winget not release

expectations.text: Scopes the Homebrew tap and Scoop bucket push tokens to those repositories only
expectations.evidence: token scoped to lumenwick/homebrew-tap only; Scoop autoupdate no token
